learning_outcomes.text: Students acquire comprehensive knowledge about theoretical concepts and models of personal development, including self-awareness, motivation, and resilience. They learn methods for effective goal setting and time management.

Students understand the importance of emotional and social intelligence in professional and personal contexts. They recognize how internal and external factors influence individual behavior and performance.
Students apply the learned concepts and techniques to foster their own personal development. They implement strategies for effective stress management and conflict resolution in practical situations.

Students develop innovative approaches to self-improvement and to managing interpersonal relationships in the workplace. They carry out self-directed projects aimed at improving specific personal or professional skills.
Students improve their communication and teamwork skills through practical exercises and group projects. They learn to communicate effectively and to act in various team constellations.

Students reflect on their learning and development processes and recognize the importance of continuous personal development. They critically evaluate the impact of their decisions and actions on their personal and professional environment.

assessment_rules: The graded examination is a semester-long learning journal of 15 pages. The ungraded examination is regular participation, defined as attendance of at least 80% of the course sessions. A key element of the module is continuous journaling of one's own actions and self-reflection.
